::: {#exr-file-check}
#### When does the program complain?

A program reads a file if the file exists and is readable,
and prints an error otherwise.
Let $E$ be "the file exists" and $R$ be "the file is readable".
The program prints an error when $\neg (E \land R)$ is true.

Describe when the program prints an error
with a sentence that puts "not" only in front of $E$ or $R$,
never in front of a compound proposition.

:::
